# Map Shows Trump’s Approval Rating in Every State 2 Months Until Midterms

Published

Sep 03, 2026 at 05:00 AM EDT

updated

Sep 03, 2026 at 12:34 PM EDT

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

With two months to go until Americans vote in the 2026 midterm elections, new polling shows President Donald Trump facing a political landscape that has deteriorated significantly since the start of his second term.

The data comes from Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. [...] A Newsweek analysis compares Trump's approval rating on August 31, 2026, with where it stood when he returned to office on January 20, 2025, with net approval calculated as approve minus disapprove.

results.content:
YouGov polls about 1,500 members of its national opt-in panel weekly using online questionnaires. State-level approval rates are “estimated” based on demographic characteristics, voting behavior, the state’s voting history and other data. Nationally, YouGov’s tracker shows 34% approving of Trump’s job performance and 61% disapproving, for a net approval rating of -27. [...] In May, a poll of 875 likely voters conducted by Keloland Media Group and Emerson College showed Trump with a 53% approval rating, while 42% disapproved.

Civiqs estimated that 51% of South Dakotans approved of Trump’s job performance as of Aug. 11.

This fact brief responds to claims such as this one.
